source_smoke: 768/768 Python tests passed on the full-suite run after the F-069 auth Child-RPC migration (v1 auth routes now execute inside the account Child process through audited eitaa.auth.* RPC); zero failures or errors, including 7 new end-to-end auth regression tests that spawn a real Child.
installed_wheel_smoke: The installer builder rebuilt the bridge wheel from current source, passed allowlist dry-run and wheel/source parity, installed cryptography and all other runtime packages from local wheels only, and passed runtime checker plus install-copy and packaged activation simulations.
typescript: Full TypeScript project check and UI/Electron observability contract passed after the internal code-signing changes; UI source was unchanged.
vite_production_build: Local Vite production build passed after G-11 with 1015 modules; the compatibility runtime patch is emitted under a SHA-256-derived filename and ui/dist is intentionally excluded from the clean source archive.
contact_source_contract: Actual Eitaa server contacts are listed, added and removed through Core contacts.getContacts/importContacts/deleteContacts. A persistent local directory remains separate and supports categories, manual/file imports, local snapshots and resolved phone lists.
deduplication_contract: Normalized phone and Eitaa user ID are matched transactionally; duplicate imports update/merge instead of creating a second local contact; category links merge; opt-out and sendable state are preserved.
audience_handoff_contract: Only contacts in selected local categories are queried for the target view. No selected category means zero visible target contacts. A unique preview with exclusions and safety cap is handed to the existing send form; no send starts automatically.
migration_contract: No schema-number change in GMI4.2. Core schema remains 9, content-index schema 2 and contact schema 1.
installer_change_scope: RC6 keeps the RC5 graphical Persian Windows 10/11 x64 self-contained installer, AppUser auth, multi-session and isolated workers in the packaged default, and completes the F-069 fix: after an explicit worker Start, the whole v1 auth lifecycle (status, request-code, submit-code, submit-password, reset-local-session, logout) now executes inside the account Child process via a fenced DTO-only RPC allowlist instead of failing with the unmigrated-route gate error. recover-phone-identity stays parent-side because it swaps the DPAPI identity key. Setup remains per-user, branded, internally signed and privacy-scanned, with Python bundled and no target Node.js requirement.
pytest_environment_note: The activation RED run had five expected product failures plus two host Temp setup errors. RC4 validation used an explicit workspace basetemp and disabled pytest cache after inherited ACLs rejected the default Temp/cache paths; final full acceptance passed 690/690 with no failures, errors or skips.
stabilization_acceptance: G-00 through G-09 complete and explicitly accepted by the user; G-10 removed the stale selected-group request rewrite but browser delivery remained stale; G-11 repaired immutable fixed-name runtime-patch caching and passed full automated acceptance; one user visual recheck after application restart remains pending
deferred_issues: Replace the unencrypted branch-test signing key with an owner-controlled encrypted Production key, offline backup and rotation/revocation procedure
Provide the approved source icon, build/sign the final RC3, then complete Windows 10/11 visual and clean real-user installer acceptance
Server contact person photos for users absent from the dialog catalog require a future Core profile-photo model extension
Message template editor/executor after a separately approved architecture stage
Production multi-account workers after isolated lab approval
DC distribution or account-limit avoidance is intentionally not implemented
Red/unselectable Eitaa message after appending to an existing WordPress post remains deferred
summary: GMI4.2 adds real Eitaa server contacts in the right menu, a simplified persistent local address book with strict category target filtering, optional add-to-Eitaa on manual/file imports, lazy/cached avatars, and a safe quick-send composer under the conversation. Material UI RTL/dark/responsive behavior from GMI4.1 is retained and corrected.
material_ui_contract: MUI ThemeProvider, RTL Emotion cache, responsive Grid/Dialog/Stack/Paper/TextField surfaces and full-screen mobile dialogs are the UI baseline. The virtualized message list remains custom for performance.
legacy_dist_in_bundle: ui/dist is excluded from the clean source archive, while the separate self-contained Setup embeds the validated current prebuilt Material UI runtime and verifies its marker before building
backend_change_scope: Bridge API now exposes real Eitaa contacts and safe quick-send routes; all Eitaa RPCs still use the existing scheduler and single-session Core.
npm_install_script_policy: package.json explicitly reviews electron and esbuild install scripts through allowScripts.
person_avatar_limitation: contacts.getContacts profile photos are not exposed by the current Core User model. A person avatar is fetched when the same user has a valid photo reference in the dialog catalog; otherwise initials are shown.
message_template_scope: Only a disabled UI attachment point and architecture document are included. No template execution, scheduling or automatic send is implemented.
clean_release_contract: The RC5 installer rebuilds the wheel from current source, verifies allowlist and wheel/source parity, installs runtime dependencies from local wheels, and runs a content scanner before packaging. Operational state, private-key filenames and complete private-key PEM blocks are rejected. The Authenticode key remains non-exportable outside the project; previous named Setup and Portable artifacts are moved to timestamped archives with SHA-256 manifests rather than deleted.

self_contained_setup.activation_store: Windows user-scoped DPAPI plus signed device fingerprint

offline_activation.clipboard_controls: explicit copy, explicit paste, context menus and physical-key shortcuts independent of Persian/English layout

legacy_checksums_scope: CHECKSUMS.sha256 is a historical GMI artifact; current clean archive integrity is owned by _release/CONTENT_MANIFEST.json and its external receipt.
